extraction_notes: The title and function diagram identify D882 as an NPN transistor; the pin map is base at pin 1, collector at pin 2, and emitter at pin 3.
The hFE table gives a 60 minimum to 400 maximum bound at IC = 1.0 A and VCE = 2 V, plus a 32 minimum at IC = 100 mA and VCE = 2 V; no typical hFE was inferred from these bounds.

Only compact observed DC F2 evidence is retained: the directly digitized IB = 4 mA static-characteristic trace and TA = 25 degC DC-current-gain trace. Points are plotted observations and were not interpolated between table values.

VCBO = 40 V, VEBO = 6.0 V, IC = 3.0 A, and PC = 500 mW maximum ratings are present on p. 1; the strict BJT schema has no fields for these limits. The Fig. 6 capacitance plot is non-DC evidence and is omitted from the compact curve set, so cobo and cibo remain null.
